segments.text:
V. 3.
Jeſus anſwered, Neither hath this man ſinned, nor his parents—It was not the Manner of our LORD to anſwer any Queſtions that were of no Uſe, but to gratify an idle Curioſity. Therefore He determines Nothing concerning this The Scope of his Anſwer is, It was neither for any Sins of his own, nor of his Parents; but that the Power of GOD might be diſplayed.
